حِبْنٌ and ↓ حِبْنَةٌ i. q. دُمَّلٌ [all which are applied in the present day to A boil]: (K:) and [small swellings or pustules, of the kind termed] خُرَاج, (K,) like دُمَّل: (S K:) or a thing that comes upon the body, or person, generating pus, or thick purulent matter, and swelling: pl. [of the former] حُبُونٌ. (K.) ＝
-A2- Also, the former, An ape, or a monkey; syn. قِرْدٌ. (Kr, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
